bio.text: Bryan McCarty is the Democratic candidate for Wyoming Secretary of State in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia lists the candidate as advancing from the August 18 Democratic primary.
In the WyoFile election guide response, McCarty says the birthplace is Mansfield, Ohio, and the current home is Worland.
McCarty describes a career mostly in the railroad industry, with internal audit and Six Sigma training.
